description: Three defence towers (reach 200) on the Ironwood build list, at fixed places around the base, and a build button for them in the worker's command set. The computer players build them (the skirmish build code builds the build list entries of the power kind by itself; the tower is of that kind and of the defence kind, which the terrain-aware defence moves to the ways into the base).

edits.append:
; Bench overlay: the gun of a defence tower (reach 200).
Weapon IronwoodGeoTowerGun
  PrimaryDamage = 9.0
  PrimaryDamageRadius = 0.0
  AttackRange = 200.0
  DamageType = ARMOR_PIERCING
  DeathType = NORMAL
  WeaponSpeed = 999999.0
  FireFX = FX_StarterCannonShot
  ClipSize = 0
  ClipReloadTime = 0
  DelayBetweenShots = 700
  AntiAirborneVehicle = No
  AntiGround = Yes
End

; Bench overlay: a defence tower that the computer players put on their build list. (KindOf FS_POWER is how the skirmish
; build code picks it up by itself: it builds the entries of the power kind of the build list in order.)
Object IronwoodGeoTower
  Buildable = Yes
  Scale = 0.7
  Side = Ironwood
  EditorSorting = STRUCTURE
  DisplayName = OBJECT:IronwoodPowerPlant
  Draw = W3DModelDraw ModuleTag_Draw
    OkToChangeModelColor = Yes
    DefaultConditionState
      Model = iw_power
    End
  End
  KindOf = STRUCTURE SELECTABLE IMMOBILE CAN_ATTACK FS_BASE_DEFENSE FS_POWER SCORE CAN_SEE_THROUGH_STRUCTURE
  Body = StructureBody ModuleTag_Body
    MaxHealth = 450.0
    InitialHealth = 450.0
  End
  ArmorSet
    Conditions = None
    Armor = IronwoodStructureArmor
    DamageFX = None
  End
  WeaponSet
    Conditions = None
    Weapon = PRIMARY IronwoodGeoTowerGun
  End
  Behavior = AIUpdateInterface ModuleTag_AI
    Turret
      TurretTurnRate = 180
      TurretPitchRate = 60
      ControlledWeaponSlots = PRIMARY
      AllowsPitch = No
    End
    AutoAcquireEnemiesWhenIdle = Yes
  End
  Behavior = DestroyDie ModuleTag_Destroy
  End
  Behavior = FXListDie ModuleTag_DeathFX
    DeathFX = FX_StarterBuildingDie
  End
  Prerequisites
    Object = IronwoodPowerPlant
  End
  BuildCost = 350
  BuildTime = 8.0
  VisionRange = 220.0
  ShroudClearingRange = 260.0
  RadarPriority = STRUCTURE
  Geometry = CYLINDER
  GeometryMajorRadius = 16.0
  GeometryMinorRadius = 16.0
  GeometryHeight = 20.0
  GeometryIsSmall = No
End

edits.find:
Structure IronwoodFactory
      Location = X:60 Y:-60
      Rebuilds = 3
      Angle = 0.0
      InitiallyBuilt = No
      AutomaticallyBuild = Yes
    End
edits.replace:
Structure IronwoodFactory
      Location = X:60 Y:-60
      Rebuilds = 3
      Angle = 0.0
      InitiallyBuilt = No
      AutomaticallyBuild = Yes
    End
    Structure IronwoodGeoTower
      Location = X:150 Y:0
      Rebuilds = 3
      Angle = 0.0
      InitiallyBuilt = No
      AutomaticallyBuild = Yes
    End
    Structure IronwoodGeoTower
      Location = X:0 Y:150
      Rebuilds = 3
      Angle = 0.0
      InitiallyBuilt = No
      AutomaticallyBuild = Yes
    End
    Structure IronwoodGeoTower
      Location = X:-150 Y:0
      Rebuilds = 3
      Angle = 0.0
      InitiallyBuilt = No
      AutomaticallyBuild = Yes
    End

edits.append:
; Bench overlay: the worker can build the tower.
CommandButton Command_ConstructIronwoodGeoTower
  Command = DOZER_CONSTRUCT
  Object = IronwoodGeoTower
  TextLabel = CONTROLBAR:ConstructIronwoodBarracks
  ButtonImage = SP_Barracks
  ButtonBorderType = BUILD
  DescriptLabel = CONTROLBAR:ToolTipConstructIronwoodBarracks
End
